title: Silicon-based anodes for solid-state batteries: challenges, opportunities, and multiscale strategies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,33561-33585
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05126F, Review Article

Zhenjun Zhang, Xiangyong Xue, Zuxue Mo, Xiaoxu Lei, Xuerui Xie, Haiqing Qin, Yilong Wu, Haowen Jiang, Huijie Tang
In this work, we review the challenges and opportunities of silicon-based anodes in solid-state batteries, propose a multi-level optimization strategy, and discuss future research directions.
